title: StockReservationConfirmationFailed
description: Reply (ADR 0006). Published by inventory-service through its outbox (aggregateType=StockReservation, key=orderId). Consumed by order-service, which deduplicates by (orderId, causationId, eventType) and saga state. Nothing was confirmed.

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).

causationId.description: eventId of the command this replies to (for a re-published reply: the duplicate command's eventId).

reason.description: UNKNOWN_ORDER: no reservation for this order (inventory then closes the order: a later reserve is rejected ORDER_CLOSED, a repeated confirm answers ORDER_CLOSED); ORDER_CLOSED: released or rejected; NOT_RESERVED: at least one line expired or was released.
